ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Hover steps
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Pickle steps that put the pointer over a tooltip region and wait for the game to draw the tooltip, so that a scenario can capture it or assert it. Developer tooling; no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See HoverSteps/README.md at the repository root.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps. Runtime coverage and limitations are documented in the repository.
